options.content:
Home Assistant battery sensors. Healthy >20%, warning >10% to 20%, critical 0% to 10%. Counts are distinct battery entities, not guaranteed unique physical devices. Predicted charge and trip-end estimates are excluded. Unknown means missing, unavailable, invalid or stale telemetry. Inventory uses battery sensors seen in the last 30 days that still have an availability entity. Never-observed battery sensors and voltage-only devices are not covered.

Green, amber and red indicate explicit status. Blue is quantitative emphasis. N/A means missing or unsupported data, never healthy zero.
